title: Firmware rollout: failure tracking that only works against an in-memory fake
name: OTA rollout failures

questions.prompt: In production, thermostats that fail every firmware install are never quarantined: they get offered the same broken update forever, and the rollout dashboard shows them as "updating" with 0 failures. The old unit tests, which used a Map of device objects as the registry, all passed. The new test suite uses a fake that stores copies, like the real registry does. Fix rollout.ts so the tests pass.
